# NASA CGI Moon Kit color map

`lroc_color_poles_1k.jpg` is the 1024 × 512 sRGB lunar color map from NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio CGI Moon Kit (2019 map).

- Source: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720
- Direct asset: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004700/a004720/lroc_color_poles_1k.jpg
- Credit requested by the source: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio
- Visualizer: Ernie Wright (USRA)
- Source data: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera / LROC WAC color mosaic, with polar coverage supplemented from LRO LOLA albedo data
- Retrieved: 2026-08-26
- SHA-256: `b246064f217f8d479df78c49c7c8595a8f5fbda008a72fd539978d2e121e0109`

The asset is used as a compact albedo/color texture. Runtime lighting, lunar phase, atmospheric transmittance, and tone mapping remain shader-driven.
